generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For all Criteria refer bid document

itemList.description: Dewatering by mechanical means including hire charges of machinery,fuel and crew charges etc., complete as per the direction of the Engineer- in charge (statement of hire charges of machinery for the year. with all lead and lift, loading and unloading as per the directions of engineer in charge of work. 5 HP Diesel pump

Excavation and removal of silt or slush in marshy condition by mechanical means from Silt traps/Inlets/tank bed using shovel 0.85 cum 110hp , including stacking the same for drying and loading & unloading of the same using Tipper 10 m3, Excluding cost of haulage, including cost of machinary, labour etc., with initial lead upto 50 m and all lifts complete as per the direction of the engineer in charge of work.

Cost of Haulage Excluding Loading and Unloading . Case-1 : Surfaced Road. B. Taking output 18 tonne load and lead of 15 km is considered as per specifications and directions of the engineer in charge of work

Providing and constructing rockfill embankment with graded rubble of 400 mm and down size from approved quarry including spreading and compacting by vibratory rollers in layers not exceeding 600 mm and finishing the sides to the required slopes including cost of all materials, machinery, labour etc., complete with all leads and lifts. (For Dam and Allied works)

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead.By Mechanical means. A Dismantling Brick / Tile work / rubble masonry / pitching / etc by mechanical means

Carefully dismantling and removing the damaged, displaced or disturbed portion of the existing rockfill embankment/bund consisting of graded rubble up to 400 mm size, including removal of vegetation, silt, soil and other objectionable materials; sorting, cleaning and stacking the serviceable stones separately within a lead of 50 m; preparing, trimming and dressing the exposed foundation and adjoining sound rockfill surface; and reconstructing the rockfill embankment using the recovered serviceable stones, including loading, conveying, spreading and arranging the stones in layers not exceeding 600 mm thickness, filling interstices with available smaller stones and spalls, compacting each layer using suitable vibratory roller or approved mechanical compaction equipment, finishing the top and sides to the required lines, levels and slopes, including all labour, machinery, tools, tackles, incidental handling, leads and lifts, complete as per drawings, specifications and directions of the Engineer-in-Charge. Note: Cost of new stones required to make good any shortage shall be measured and paid separately under the applicable rockfill embankment item.
